name: Davao City

queries.query: Davao City mapa ng lupa mapa sa lote cadastral tax mapping City Assessor opisyal
queries.scope: Find first-party local land-parcel mapping and a public cadastral geometry endpoint.
queries.result: Native-language search terms surfaced the City Government of Davao City Assessor and the official GIS portal. The local assessor explicitly maintains a tax-mapping system. The current 2026 Citizens’ Charter says Map Verification requires an in-person request, government ID, title copy and PHP 50 per parcel. No public parcel-vector route was found.
queries.executionMethod: Native-language search terms plus official City Assessor, city GIS and Citizens’ Charter pages; no personal/property data was entered.

queries.query: Davao City official cadastral parcel map tax mapping City Assessor WFS public GIS
queries.scope: Cross-check the public Davaomap layers against local assessor tax-map services.
queries.result: The City Assessor states that it maintains real-property tax maps and records. The official public Davaomap describes boundaries, barangays, streets and zoning; the public GeoServer lists 35 map feature types but no parcel/title cadastral layer. The current 2026 Map Verification transaction requires an ID and title copy and costs PHP 50 per parcel. No public full parcel geometry was retrieved.
queries.executionMethod: Separate English-language search, official GIS/app script and GeoServer capabilities inspection, and official City Assessor service charter.

portals.name: City Assessor’s Office (CASSO)
portals.observation: First-party office page says CASSO maintains tax mapping, property assessment and records services for the city.

portals.name: Davaomap / Davao City Webmaps
portals.operator: City Planning and Development Office, City Government of Davao
portals.observation: Public web map exposes streets/roads, rivers, barangay and district boundaries, congressional boundaries and zoning. GeoServer capabilities list 35 public map feature types; no parcel or cadastral type appeared.

portals.name: CASSO Map Verification
portals.operator: City Assessor’s Office – Tax Mapping Division
portals.observation: Current 2026 official Citizens’ Charter describes an in-person request to verify a property location in the tax map, requiring a request form, government ID, title copy and official receipt; PHP 50 per parcel.

portals.name: Davao City GIS Division
portals.operator: Office of the City Planning and Development Coordinator
portals.observation: Official page offers GIS data/maps on request through the office; it does not advertise parcel vector downloads.

requests.observation: City Government page identifies Davaomap as the official city GIS and describes boundaries, barangays, roads and zoning.
Public map UI lists only general reference layers, district/ barangay boundaries, streets, rivers and zoning.
Public app script configures WFS search against Davao:Barangay; no parcel feature request is present in this map's search flow.
GeoServer capabilities enumerate 35 feature types, including Barangay, district, Streets and zoning/risk layers; none is a parcel/title/cadastral feature type.
Official office page establishes city tax-mapping and real-property records services.
Current 2026 Citizens’ Charter documents in-person Map Verification, required ID/title documents, an official receipt and PHP 50 per parcel.

freshResearch.executionMethod: Filipino/Cebuano-language search terms and English official-source search; direct read-only WFS capability and static JavaScript inspection; no parcel or owner query.

verifiedParcelResponse.limitations: The public GIS has non-parcel city reference layers. Local City Assessor maintains tax maps, but map verification is a document/request workflow. No parcel API or geometry query was made.

source.name: Davao City Assessor tax-mapping and property-record system
source.serviceType: Local tax mapping and property records; public parcel-vector format not verified.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: CASSO maintains real-property assessment, tax mapping and records for its municipal jurisdiction.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Davaomap's open layers cover city reference and zoning themes. The parcel-level tax map is handled through the City Assessor's application/verification workflow; no open vector endpoint was confirmed.

registryBasis: First-party Davao City Assessor says it maintains the city's tax-mapping system and real-property records; its official Map Verification service explicitly handles property location in the tax map.
technicalBlocker: The official city GIS exposes general reference, boundaries, roads, zoning and risk layers, but GeoServer capabilities contain no parcel/title layer. Parcel map verification requires an in-person request with an ID and title copy plus fee.
remainingUncertainty: Whether CASSO or CPDO has a separately published non-indexed parcel map accessible to the public; the current public web-map and service documentation provide no such route.
nextStep: Keep runtime disabled. If the City Assessor publishes an open parcel-vector endpoint, verify a bounded WUP-neighborhood feature response before adapter work.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
